title: Interviewed by New Scientist on modelling Arctic sea ice
article_title: Could geoengineering ‘ice arches’ help preserve Arctic sea ice?
author: Alec Luhn
image_alt: New Scientist headline: Could geoengineering ‘ice arches’ help preserve Arctic sea ice?
description: New Scientist spoke to Michel Tsamados and me about our work at UCL modelling how the ice arches in the Nares Strait, between Greenland and Ellesmere Island, break up — and whether thickening them could keep sea ice locked in the Arctic Ocean for longer. I described the idea as adding “some cement between the pieces of the arch”.
